scope: Proposition 9.1 (Movement and success) of the manuscript “Planar Graph Metrics Embed into L1 with Constant Distortion” (preprints/Planar-Graph-Metrics-Embed-into-L1-with-Constant-Distortion-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 089 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 11b3a102e7333bf8), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 39. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There are constants M < ∞ and b, p > 0 such that the following hold at every step of scale r. (i) At every point of X, in either system, the symmetric-difference movement of the unrefined set is at most Mr. (ii) Given any past for which a vertex pair at distance in [r, 2r) is eligible, the step has probability at least p of producing one of these certificates: (a) unrefined symmetric-difference separation at least br in one system; (b) a non-neighbor tip e and a set of labels of measure at least br in system A on which both pair vertices are active and e is inactive, with the vertices strictly on opposite sides of that link.
